html:
I’ve been to Hong Kong once. I spent most of the time with German colleagues, speaking either English or German, and the service staff we met were all fine. One waiter even whispered to me something to the effect that he envied me for having foreign friends.

The only time I went out on my own was to Superdry on Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui, and the young woman working there couldn’t have been nicer, and very cute too (I walked out with three items of clothing).

So overall I have a very good impression of Hong Kong.
